title: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unpaid order confirmation via PayPal Checkout order completion task in VirtueMart…
description: A vulnerability in the VirtueMart Joomla extension versions 4.0.0 through 4.8.8 allows an attacker, including guest users, to mark unpaid orders as confirmed and paid via the PayPal Checkout payment plugin's order completion task. This occurs because the plugin sets the order status to success without verifying PayPal payment capture or authorization. The issue is fixed in version 4.8.10.
